note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (President Kuchma newly re-elected, Yushchenko government just appointed), not measured data. Influence reflects large business groups formed during privatisation, a strong presidential administration and security services, weak independent unions, and a broadcast media dominated by the state and business owners.

interest_groups.note: Successor unions of the Soviet era; wage and pension arrears were common.
Large Russian-speaking population in the east and south, Crimean Tatars, and other minorities.
